Results: defect rate 1.4% for Text to Text Safety and 4.5% for Image to Text Safety.
Quotes given as evidence (separated by [...]): Automated red teaming was performed on Azure to assess safety risks across multiple risk categories, including disallowed content (sexual, violent, hateful, or self-harm content), copyright content and intellectual property, and jailbreak susceptibility. [...] | Text to Text Safety | Automated content safety evaluation measuring safety policies | 1.4% | [...] | Image to Text Safety | Automated content safety evaluation measuring safety policies | 4.5% |

Grade the extraction:
- "y": the quotes are about this model and support every claim in the value, and the value answers the fact definition.
- "partial": mostly right, but the value adds claims the quotes don't support, drops an important qualifier, or only partly answers the definition.

answer.reason: The quotes support the red-teaming categories (disallowed content, copyright/IP, jailbreak) and both defect rates (1.4% Text to Text, 4.5% Image to Text). But the value also says groundedness was assessed. The card says this elsewhere, but none of the quotes given as evidence support it, so the value contains a claim its quotes don't back up.
